text.en:
THE SCHEDULE
Rules 2(b), 3(b), 4(b),
5(b), 6(b) and 7(b)
Colours for ribbons of
Medals awarded for COVID‑19 contributions
1. The ribbon has a red stripe at its centre, flanked on each side by a white stripe, a light turquoise stripe, and a dark turquoise stripe, in that order.
2. To avoid doubt, the shape of the ribbon is governed by the subsidiary legislation instituting the Medal.
